## 2026-11-12: Reply to one message (GitHub issue #3: "You can reply to a specific conversation, much like in Dots or Muse… to address multiple issues simultaneously"; the author: "the visual expression maxed out, our style's mechanism, emotional value and distinctive stylization, with matching animation; the context design designed and reflected on carefully, to the max; reference other apps where apt")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D236 | **回复 / Reply to one message: the imprint, a quote that travels with the reply, and routing by what was replied to. Built 2026-11-12 on the web (phone and wide), the iPhone shell and the Mac app; for the author's review.** (1) **Gestures:** swipe a bubble right on the phone (starts at 14pt, arms at 56pt with a light haptic, a drawn reply mark easing in and settling; never within 28pt of the left edge), long press or right click for **回复 / Reply · 复制 / Copy**, hover Reply beside the bubble with a mouse, and on a wide screen a selected part of the partner's words gives **回复这段 / Reply to this part**. Any bubble can be replied to, including each find of a note. (2) **The look is the imprint** (research/72: seven candidates, mapping tables, rubric, 33 haiku rater calls; 34/35): the message replied to as a small copy of its own bubble (its voice's colour and tail) pressed into the reply like a pebble into clay, its first line literal (**Ducter** or **你 / You**), two lines of quote. In the composer while writing (placeholder **回复 {who}… / Reply to {who}…**, × **不回复了 / Cancel reply**, Esc), pressed into the top of the sent bubble after, and pressed into the top of a partner answer only when that answer is not next to its reply (another message of the user came between: several replies in flight); an answer right after its reply shows no quote, adjacency says it. The imprint is debossed, the reverse of a raised clay button (its shadow under the top and left rims, a lit lower edge, its floor a little below the bubble's own colour, no border), its quote one step smaller (12) and quieter than the words, its who-line smaller still (11), so the person's words lead (the polish pass after review, 2026-11-12). Tapping it scrolls the original to the centre and deepens its own tint once (never a glow ring); one no longer on the screen says **那条在更早的对话里，这里翻不到了。/ That message is further back than this screen goes.** Reduced motion: nothing moves, the tint still changes. (3) **Context:** the client names only the message (`ReplyWant`: seq, a find, a part); core logs a `ReplyRef` inside the `user_msg` from the Log (whose words, kind, a quote of at most 200 characters, `clipped`, the tasks it was about, the question or find, its pictures), so the reference survives the window, re-cuts, digests and restarts and costs the same however long the message was. The partner reads `[user, replying to your message of … (#n): "…"]`, a line per task with where it stands and where more work goes, the pictures again, and a `log_read` pointer when cut. (4) **Routing:** a reply to an open question (a task's, or the partner's own ask) is its answer, resolved by core as Reply (`decision_resolved.msgSeq`), and the partner may not send it again (its task_send is refused); a reply about a task's work goes to that task (task_send) unless its work was merged (rule 2d); a reply to a find is about that find; anything else is conversation about that message. (5) **No cross-talk:** replies to different messages are separate turns (`turnLength`), a turn's history leaves out what is still queued, and each answer replies to its own message. A reply never forks or branches anything. (6) Persona: a "Replies" section; eval: 5 new scenarios (an older task's result, two replies at once, a find, out of the window, an open question), 5/5 on haiku; the whole suite 71/103 (the last full run, D221, 75/97; a recheck of the 32 failures passed 18 of them: haiku's run-to-run noise, none about replies). (1) **What was found (research/76):** every task's brief is appended on all four harnesses (Claude Code `--append-system-prompt-file`, Codex `developerInstructions`, pi `--append-system-prompt`, DeepSeek Harness a first-message preamble); no task's prompt is replaced. The one real weakening: Claude Code browser tasks ran with `--tools Bash,Read,Write,ToolSearch`. (2) **Claude Code, every browser place (cua-driver, Claude in Chrome, Ducter's browser):** no `--tools` allowlist; denied are Ducter's seven for every task (plan mode, Cron ×3, ScheduleWakeup, AskUserQuestion), **Agent** and **Workflow**, and on cua-driver the driver's tools outside the ten. Why those two: a subagent gets the parent's MCP tools but not its appended brief (measured, 2.1.322), so it would drive the browser with none of D62's Go and untrusted-page rules or D130's own-window rules. `userConfiguration: "exclude"` stays: it keeps the person's MCP servers, plugins, hooks and CLAUDE.md out of a session that reads hostile pages. (3) **Cost, measured** (haiku, isolated, per request): the old four 6.6K tokens, D240's set 12.2K (+5.5K), an ordinary task 17.0K; on a repeated call in a session the tool block is a cache read (a tenth of fresh input), and 5.5K is 3.4% of a task's 160K compaction point. The old 332k → 140k came from three changes at once (user config, cua-driver denials, built-ins) and can't be split; the built-ins were roughly half (INFERRED). (4) **Codex:** unchanged in code. Its clean setup for a browser task already keeps its own browser, Computer Use, plugins as a feature and image generation; `multi_agent` and `goals` stay off, now on purpose and written down (a Codex subagent's brief is unchecked; Ducter owns when a turn ends). `system.md` said only the partner dropped them; corrected. (5) **pi:** unchanged. Its clean flags (`--no-skills --no-context-files --no-prompt-templates --no-extensions --no-themes`) remove only the person's own resources; no built-in tool. (6) **DeepSeek Harness:** unchanged; its browser task keeps the person's own setup (no capability lost; the missing clean home is open in todo). (7) **Name what to deny, not what to keep:** an allowlist rots as a harness renames tools (`TodoWrite` no longer exists in 2.1.322). (8) **Open:** a live rerun of the HN lookup; whether an ordinary Codex task's subagents see the brief while Computer Use is on; `PushNotification`, `RemoteTrigger` and `Workflow` (8.2K tokens) in every ordinary Claude Code task; pi's `--no-context-files` also drops a repo's own AGENTS.md under `isolateUserConfig`. | U (the question), L (the call), research/76 | `packages/runner/src/{browser.ts,runner.ts,oar.ts}`, `packages/runner/test/{browser.test.ts,ducter-browser.test.ts}`, `design/{system.md,onboarding.md,todo.md}`, `research/76-task-tool-set.md` |
| D241 | **A task leaves out of its harness only what competes with Ducter or would act without the brief; everything else, the project's own instructions included, stays. Built 2026-11-13; checked by tests and by reading the harnesses' source (research/76 §6), not yet in a live task.** *Who:* the developer whose task should behave like their own Claude Code, Codex, pi or DSH; the consumer whose task must never push to their phone or start agents on their account behind Ducter's back; the fresh user, who sees only that tasks report through Ducter. *Feel:* before, a task could send its own push notification, schedule a remote agent, fan out a hidden workflow, lose its repo's AGENTS.md on pi, or read pages in the person's own DSH setup; after, the same harness, with Ducter the one voice. (1) **Claude Code, every task and the partner:** PushNotification (a push to the person's terminal and phone), RemoteTrigger (scheduled remote agents on the person's claude.ai account, outliving the task) and Workflow (a scripted fan-out of agents that never see the brief) join Ducter's seven denials (`oar.ts` DISALLOWED). (2) **Agent stays in ordinary tasks:** a subagent's result returns to the task, which holds the brief, and the tools that act for the person outside a browser (the phone, the person's apps) are Ducter's own, their Go gate enforced by the tool and stated in its description; only a browser place, whose tools enforce none of D62's rules, denies it (D240). (5) **DeepSeek Harness, a browser place:** a home of Ducter's for the task (`userConfiguration: "exclude"` on DSH), keyed by its folder so a changed brief resumes in the same home, the brief in that home's AGENTS.md, DSH's own tools all kept (they come from its built-in `acp` profile). (1) **The Mac (`task.go`, `onhandrail.go`):** an opened task is **On hand's rail \| the task \| the workbench (520)**, under the window's header (crumbs and the task's actions stay full width). ## 2026-11-13: The file viewer's open items (the author: "剩下的待办也都做了吧", D239's not-built list)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D242 | **D239's open items, built 2026-11-13 on the web (and so the iPhone and Android apps) and the Mac app; for the author's review: a PDF's pages drawn inside Ducter, media keys that expire, find in a long file, and the Mac's read-only views without a current line or MyGo's English "Copy".** *Who:* the developer reading a PDF report or searching a long log a task left; the consumer handed "the report" as a PDF; the fresh user who taps a PDF card and expects to read it, not to be told to save it. *Feel:* before, a PDF said "can't open this yet", a long log was scrolled by eye, and a link to a picture or file kept working forever wherever it ended up; after, the PDF's pages are simply there, ⌘F finds the word, and a link that leaks stops opening within a day, with nothing for the person to do. (1) **A PDF's pages** (`fileView` → `pdf`, `FilePDF`): one under the other, each a sheet of white paper (`--pdf-page` / `PDFPage`, the one fixed white: printed matter) on the sunken ground at the reading width; the head says **{n} 页 / {n} pages**. The web draws with pdf.js (Mozilla, Apache-2.0, `pdfjs-dist` 4.10.38: its prebuilt modules copied to `app/pdf.js` and `app/pdf.worker.js`, about 1.7 MB, loaded only when a PDF opens, `isEvalSupported: false`) from the bytes it fetched: Chromium's own reader won't run in a document served under the media CSP's `sandbox` (research/75). The Mac draws with Core Graphics (the engine Preview uses), called through purego as the app already reaches the system without cgo; MyGo has no PDF view (research/75 §5, VERIFIED by a test that draws a page). Pages are drawn as they come within about a screen of view and let go when they leave, so memory holds a few pages; at twice their width in points. A PDF that can't be drawn: **这个 PDF 在这里画不出来。存一份，用你自己的应用看。/ This PDF can't be drawn here. Save a copy and open it in your own app.** (the Mac keeps **在 Mac 上打开**). Alternative not taken: keep Open on this Mac only (no native path was missing). (2) **Expiring media keys.** `k` = `<exp>.<sig>`, an HMAC of `<id>.<exp>`, open for 24–30 hours (keys signed in one 6-hour window end together: one URL, one cache entry). The home signs every ref afresh as a frame leaves for a client (`fresh` in ws.ts `send`), so the Log keeps ids and whatever key it holds never decides, and old messages, reconnects, a first screen and a task's history all arrive with good keys; nothing in the Log is rewritten. A client holding keys past their time asks over its own connection: `media_keys {ids}` → `media_keys {mediaKeys}` (not `keys`: the saved frame's). Web (`media-fresh.ts`): the newest key per id, a stale one asked about before use, a failed picture or fetch asking once a minute at most and drawing again. Mac: the newest key per id in `protocol` (`MediaPath`), the picture cache keyed by id, failed pictures and the open file fetched again when keys come. **Migration:** a pre-D242 key (a bare HMAC of the id) opens for 7 days after the home's first expiring key (`media/.keys-expire`), then never: an old Mac app keeps its pictures across the update, and a link already in a browser's history dies within the week. The tunnel (D228) and any later relay carry the same requests; nothing changes with the path. (3) **Find in a long file:** ⌘F / Ctrl+F or the head's drawn magnifier (**查找 / Find**) in a text, a report or a table: a field pressed into the head (**在这个文件里找 / Find in this file**), **{i} / {n}** or **没找到 / No matches**, **上一个 / Previous** · **下一个 / Next** (Enter, ⌘G; ⇧ back); Esc closes the field before the file. Every match in the highlight's colours, the current one in the accent, scrolled to (across too). Case set aside, never across two lines, at most 5000 (`findAll` / `FindAll`, the same rules). The web marks with the CSS Custom Highlight API (the current match selected where a browser lacks it); the Mac marks the editor's text. MyGo's Markdown view has no ranges to mark, so on the Mac a report or a table is found in its text, and closing Find lays it out again; a PDF has no find yet. (4) **The Mac's read-only views:** the code view has no current line (`NoActiveLine`: nothing stands there); code blocks carry Ducter's own **拷贝 / Copy** (**已拷贝**) in the viewer and the conversation, not MyGo's "Copy code". | U (the author, 2026-11-13: "剩下的待办也都做了吧"), D239's list, research/75 §5 | `packages/protocol/src/{media.ts,index.ts,internal.ts}`, `packages/protocol/test/fileview.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/{media.ts,ws.ts,web.ts,assets.d.ts}`, `packages/core/test/media.test.ts`, `apps/web/{build.ts,package.json,demo-file.ts}`, `apps/web/src/{fileview.tsx,fileview-pdf.tsx,fileview-find.ts,media-fresh.ts,media.tsx,app.ts,i18n-fileview.ts}`, `apps/web/static/{app.css,app.js,pdf.js,pdf.worker.js}`, `apps/web/test/fileview-find.test.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{media/pdf_darwin.go,media/pdf_other.go,media/pdf_test.go,protocol/media.go,protocol/fileview.go,protocol/protocol.go,theme/theme.go,i18n/fileview.go,views/fileview.go,views/media.go,views/app.go}`, `design/{media.md,product-model.md,scenarios.md,todo.md}`, `docs/pictures.md`, `research/75-file-viewer.md` |

## 2026-11-13: Screens a task drives, the way people expect them (the author: "按建议 go" on bringing Rakazo's computer-use behaviours into Ducter, in Ducter's look)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D248 | **A screen a task drives is calm and honest about cost: looking never wakes it, a reconnect never flashes, the person's turn never cuts a step in half, and what it shows under the screen is what the task did, never what it read. Built 2026-11-13 for Ducter's phone on the home, the web and the Mac, with the brief rule and the 30-minute awake window; teach by showing is designed, not built. Checked by tests and headless screenshots; not yet on a real phone.** *Who:* the developer who opens a phone task's workbench to look (before, that booted a 3 GB emulator), the consumer glancing at a task that books for them, the fresh user who sees a phone screen beside a task for the first time. *Feel:* before, a black box that said 正在打开手机… on every reopen, a 接手 that could land mid-tap, nothing that said what it had done; after, a dozing phone with 叫醒, the last picture held while the new one fades in, "这一步做完就轮到你", and a short list of effects (好用, 顺滑, 赏心悦目, 放心; 惊喜: the phone dozes like the laptop does). *First time:* nothing to learn: the asleep art, one button. (1) **Asleep, never woken by looking:** a watch view of Ducter's phone when it isn't running is **asleep**: no hold, no start, no frames; it opens by itself when a task starts the phone; only **叫醒 / Wake** starts it (`phone_wake`). The art is the asleep devices' (D77, D81): the phone dozing under its knitted blanket, breathing at 4.8 s, with **Ducter 的手机睡着了 / Ducter's phone is asleep**, **看看不会叫醒它。叫醒要几秒钟，会用 {Mac} 的电和内存。** (with a task: **任务一用到它，它就会醒。**). Chosen over black glass, moon, "Zzz", a power symbol and words alone (research/82 §4.1: 5/5 LLM-proxy raters read it as asleep with Wake, 0/5 broken; black glass 2/5 broken). The device card, a card's own turn and Try it are explicit and still start it. Ducter's browser already never started from a watch (D190). The phone's card says **醒着 / 睡着了** (was 已开机 / 已关机). (2) **Smooth reconnects:** each client keeps the last frame per phone in memory; a view that opens again starts on it, a little quieter, with **正在重新连上… / Reconnecting…**; the new stream fades in over it (360 ms; none with reduced motion), the screen keeping its shape. (3) **Whose turn:** **接手 / My turn** while a phone tool is in flight waits for that step: the button reads **这一步做完就轮到你 / Yours after this step**, the line **它在做这一步，做完就停下来等你。**, and the turn is the person's when the step ends (8 s at most); tapping it again lets it be. **还给它 / Hand it back** stays one tap; **停下 / Stop** is never locked. The chip stays D214's **它在用 / 你在用** with its clay bead (raters: 4.6/5 clear, 0/5 alarmed; a red "AI is controlling" banner alarmed 5/5); it now follows the phone's turn on the web's Phone page (it was fixed to "it's driving") and is idle while asleep. (4) **它做了什么 / What it did:** the home keeps per task, in memory only, the last eight taps, typings, keys, swipes and apps opened (the screen's own labels, never typed text, never a look or a picture: proactive restraint); a watch shows the newest five under the screen: **点了「{label}」 · 在「{label}」里输入了文字 · 按了{key} · 滑动了屏幕 · 打开了 {app}**, each with a small drawn mark. ## 2026-11-13: Proactive that notices what dots noticed (the author, comparing a day of dots with Ducter: "不仅我主动问才说，根本没主动 ai，哪怕我主动问，效果也很差 … 这里对我们来说很重要")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D243 | **Restraint is about what is said, never about what is read: service notices reach triage; a trip coming up, a service the person uses and a correction are finds of their own; what can't wait has its own room and ripens with time; the home keeps the person's zone; "anything for me?" is answered from the same detectors. Built 2026-11-13 with fakes and a replay of the day (research/81); for the author's review; not yet live on hel.** *Who:* the heavy developer with production systems, travel and many tools' notices (the author); the consumer with trips and bills; the fresh user with one Gmail. *Feels:* before, "it reads my mail and tells me nothing"; after, 放心 (the edges are minded) and 惊喜 (it joined the flight with the database maintenance). *First time:* nothing new to set up. (1) **Stage 1** passes a bulk or no-reply mail to triage when its subject or sender says it may be a booking, a renewal or a billing change, maintenance, an outage, a failing job, a security alert, a shutdown, a delivery or boarding (`NOTICE_TERMS`), at most 60 a day (`NOTICE_DAY_MAX`; the rest are counted in Left out); a receipt's words alone and Gmail's Promotions never pass. (2) **Triage** gains `service` (maintenance, outage, incident, failing, security, shutdown, resolved; a window, an effect, prod) and `billing` (starts charging, price up, payment failed, over limit, trial ends); the ledger keeps two flights or two windows from one mail; a flight or train in the calendar is a booking, never a meeting. (3) **Three kinds** (ten in all): **快到了 / Coming up** (a flight or train within 36 h: when, from where, when to be there; urgent within 30 h), **你用的服务 / A service you use** (production maintenance within 48 h joined with the trip that day; an outage in the last 12 h; a job failing twice in three days or once on production; a shutdown within six weeks; a security alert, below the bar unless the model keeps it; a building's notice stays below the bar), **之前说的有变 / An update to what I told you** (a later notice that undoes or changes a find already said, said at once: a find keeps its topic and facts); money changing joins **快到期 · 要花钱**. (4) **The bar:** the informing kinds need no next step; the judge's rubric says what the cost is per kind (a person waiting is the cost; a trip or a window is worth a heads-up), sees typed details, and never writes about itself. (5) **Speaking:** urgent finds have their own room of 3 a day (`NOW_MAX`), no longer inside the note's 3; the detectors run every half hour, not only when mail arrives; with no quiet hours set, a heads-up that can wait six hours waits for 08:00 (23:00–08:00) in the person's zone. 只说急的 keeps no morning note. (6) **The zone:** the home keeps the zone the person's app last said in its hello and uses it for the note, "today" and the calendar when no quiet hours are set (hel ran in UTC). (7) **The partner:** a `noticed` tool (the same detectors, ranked, said or not, How I know, the next step) and a persona rule: asked what is worth knowing, `noticed` first, at most four, time-bound first, one line each, never what it read, checked or hadn't told them. Replay (`bun packages/partner/eval/proactive/day.ts`): 每天最多 3 件 1/7 → 7/7 in time, 0 false alarms; 只说急的 1/7 → 5/7 (the two left are a shutdown called off before it was urgent: correctly never said). Tradeoff: up to 60 more cheap-model reads a day per source (≤ ~0.75M tokens a month, inside the 2M budget). Alternative: per-item model judgement instead of detectors (`todo.md`, needs the author's labelled week). | the author, 2026-11-13; research/81 | `connectors.md` §1.3, §4, §5; `product-model.md`; `docs/accounts.md`; `packages/core/src/proactive/`; `packages/partner/src/persona.ts`; web and Mac `kind.*` |

| D245 | **A routine fires robustly, and "when something changes" is watched without a model. Ducter's routine model stays (proposal card, budget, review date); only its firing changes. Built 2026-11-13; checked by fake-clock tests, not yet in a live run.** *Who:* all three. The consumer has a "good morning" routine and a home that sleeps. The developer has hourly watchers whose account gets signed out overnight. The fresh user says "whenever a new file shows up in ~/Downloads/invoices, rename it" and never hears the words cron or trigger. *Feel:* before, a run after a restart said "good morning" at 3 pm, a signed-out account failed every tick until the routine paused itself for "3 runs in a row didn't work", a catch-up just after a restart could be skipped because the runner wasn't wired yet, and a watched folder cost a model look. After, a run knows it is late; a hiccup is retried once; a sign-in problem is said once and fixes itself when the person signs in; nothing is spent until something changes. (1) **Late:** a run that starts 15 min or more after its time gets a line in its brief: "This run started late: it was due {time} and started {time} ({n} min late) … adapt anything that depends on the time of day, skip steps that no longer make sense, and mention the delay when it matters". The user's own routines (D185) get it too, after their words. The run's line on the shelf says **晚了 12 分钟 / 12 min late** (from 90 min on, **晚了 n 小时 / n h late**). (2) **One safe retry:** a failed run is tried once more, 12 min later, if all three hold: it had not acted, it was not cancelled by the person or stopped by its budget, and the next firing is more than 30 min away. *Acted* means one of these appeared on the run's task before it failed: a tool call other than a pure read (`Read`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `LS`, `WebFetch`, `WebSearch`, `TodoWrite`, Ducter's `report_to_main`, `checkpoint`, `log_read`, `log_search`, `memory_search`, `task_read`); a report that posted something (progress, needs input, blocked); or a question from it. A run that never opened (the runner threw) has not acted. A retried failure doesn't count toward "3 in a row"; the retry's outcome does. The shelf says **{time}再试一次 / Tries again {time}**. (3) **Account errors space the routine out:** these are signed out, a key refused, or the allowance or plan used up. Ducter reads them from the task's failure reason or report, loosely, in en and zh (`troubleOf`, INFERRED from harness and CLI errors). The routine is tried again by itself after 5 min, doubling up to 24 h. While the firing is still worth running (min(period / 2, 12 h) after its time) it is that same firing, if it hadn't acted. Times that come up meanwhile fold into the next try, so an hourly routine never fails every hour. The first such error stays quiet. At the second in a row the partner says once, in one line, what to do (**暂时跑不了：要重新登录 / Can't run for now: needs signing in again**, or **…额度用完了 / …out of allowance**, on the shelf with **{time}再试一次**). The first run that works clears it, and the partner says so in a few words. Account errors count toward "3 in a row" only once the spacing has reached 24 h. Resuming a routine clears it. (4) **One catch-up:** D114's coalescing stays (one late run within min(period / 2, 12 h), else one skip). A retry, a try after an account error and a catch-up are one pending firing, never two runs. The startup gap is fixed: a firing that finds the runner not yet wired (right after a restart) waits 10 s and tries again within its window, instead of being recorded as skipped. A condition routine's watch that is still armed across a restart is kept, not doubled (before, every restart left one more watcher looking). (5) **When something changes (a model-free watch):** a condition routine may carry `watch` instead of a check or event. It watches exactly one of four things: files (names, sizes and modification times; a folder's direct entries; this computer only for now); a reading command under the check rules; a URL (one GET through the check rules' curl); or an app's reading tool, through Ducter's own look (`role: "watch"`, writes refused). Optional `path`, `key` and `fields` pick the list that matters and the fields that name an item, so a fetch time doesn't count and the run hears what is **new, updated, gone** (as untrusted data). The first look only learns what is there; a later look that differs starts one run, and the watch re-arms from what it saw, across restarts. A look that errors is never a change; it backs off as checks do. The proposal card's dry run says what it sees now ("sees 2 now"). Its **花多少 / Cost** row says honestly **只在有变化时用你的 AI 额度；平时看一眼不花 / Uses your AI allowance only when something changed; looking costs nothing**. A check routine without a judge says **只在条件满足时用你的 AI 额度；平时看一眼不花 / …only when it holds…**; a judge still costs a little per change, so it keeps the old line. On screen it is never "cron", "trigger" or "watch": the routine's name and its condition in words say what it waits for, as on New task's **等条件满足 / When something happens**. (6) **An unsure check asks rather than acts** (rakazo §8.6). A watch whose look can't be trusted (three or more items all gone at once) starts no run. Instead it puts one card: **例行「{name}」这次看到的跟平时很不一样（…），可能是没看对。要照样做一次吗？/ The routine "{name}" saw something unusual this time (…); it may not have looked right. Run it anyway?**, with Go **照样做 / Run it anyway** and default Hold. The watch rests until the person answers: Go runs it and lets the watch learn afresh; Hold watches on from what it saw before, so a source that comes back is no change. Every partner run's brief also says "If you are unsure whether a step is wanted or safe, don't do it: ask in your report instead". (7) **Partner tool:** `routine_propose`'s trigger description gains the watch shape. `routine_list` adds a run's lateness and retry time and a routine's account trouble. A fresh eval was run (D175), with a new scenario `routine-change-en`. *Runner-up rejected:* a separate trigger kind for changes. A watch is a condition the code can decide, and folding it into `condition` keeps one shelf card, one proposal card and one waiter path. *Not done:* rakazo's "post No changes" (silence is success); a watch's files on a worker; the routine-proposal guidance line "a repeating job carries out the user's lasting request each time" (a persona change of its own). | U ("按建议", 2026-11-13), research/77 §4, §8.2, §8.3, §8.6 | `packages/core/src/{routines.ts,waiters.ts,work.ts,core.ts}`, `packages/protocol/src/{index.ts,watch.ts,checks-run.ts}`, `packages/partner/src/{partner.ts,render.ts}`, `packages/partner/eval/scenarios.ts`, `packages/core/test/routine-runs.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/{work.tsx,i18n.ts}`, `apps/desktop/internal/{views/work.go,protocol/protocol.go,i18n/i18n.go}`, `design/{product-model.md,flows/B-kinds-of-work.md,scenarios.md,todo.md}`, `docs/waiting-and-routines.md` |

## 2026-11-13: Bridge against the real Mem (the author: "the first real trial ran end to end … S1 1/4, S2 1/4, S3 1/3, X1 1/3; diagnose and fix")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D249 | **Bridge reads Mem as it really answers (nmem 0.10.118, Mem Cloud, VERIFIED 2026-11-13): a message names no sender and no parent, so in the user's "Only me" place every sender is one of their own agents, an agent that wrote is reached again by `reply` on its latest message, and silence after such a send is never nagged about when an unnamed own agent has written since. Built and run live: S1 6/6, S3 3/3, X1 3/3, S2 4/5; the fifth (the answer linked to the question) waits on Mem (B17).** *Who:* the heavy multi-agent developer first (a terminal Claude Code beside Ducter), and the consumer user whose other AI tools write to Ducter. *Feel:* before, the first real run muted the terminal's request ("another agent", not the user's), sent the user's question to an unrelated agent of theirs whose mailbox no longer exists ("Claude 收尾协调", 409, outcome unknown) and then offered "再发一次"; after, the request is the user's own and gets its card, the question reaches exactly the agent that wrote, and nothing is ever re-sent. (1) **Own place, own agents.** When `open` names no member and the saved context's Space is `personal-<its custodian>` (read locally with `agents context show`), the message is the user's own; anywhere else an unnamed sender stays someone else's (the safe side). `reply_to` is the message's own reply handle, never a parent; only a different one, or `in_reply_to`, links a reply. (2) **Named for the user** as **你的另一个 AI / your other AI agent**; the model is told it is one of the user's own and to call it by what it says it is. An asker card from it names 另一个 AI / other AI agent as the agent (the clients' template "你的 %s 问你" leaves a space before a Chinese name: todo). (3) **Reaching the one that wrote.** `bridge_contacts` returns `wroteLately` (up to 3 recent incoming messages, newest first, each with its first words) ahead of Mem's named cards, with a note to send to the newest when the user means an agent that has written, and to use a named card only when the user used that very name. Sending to one goes by `reply` on that message (Mem routes it to its sender); the op stays the user's question (no `inReplyTo`), so follow-through still applies. The send card adds **（就是发来「…」的那个）** so the tap confirms the recipient. (4) **Never a replacement.** `bridge_send` refuses while an earlier message to the same contact is `sending` or `unknown` ("Ducter is still finding out whether your earlier message went out"). Mem's 409 `cloud_agent_original_selection_unavailable` stays unknown and is recovered by inspect → resume on the same original (D106). (5) **Unlinked answers.** Because Mem links no reply, a sent question to an unnamed own agent counts as maybe-answered once such an agent writes after it; follow-through stays silent then (restraint over a wrong nag). (6) **A request for work is work**: the X1 hint now says a goal, fix or build request is asked as Go = open a task, never as the user's call (live: haiku turned S1 into an asker card). (7) **The fake answers in the real shapes** by default (`NMEM_FAKE_SHAPE=named` keeps the old one for the partner eval's teammates), plus `agents context show` and the 409. The live driver waits for in-flight sends before checking and checks X1's answer as a reply to the asking message. *Not changed:* the persona and every tool name and description (fingerprint unchanged; the bridge eval scenarios re-run: 4/4 with one judge re-run on result length). | Live trial ×3 on the author's Mac, raw nmem output under `ducter-evidence/bridge/raw-2026-11-13T07-{27-26,44-31,51-45,56-28}*`; research/66 §7 | `packages/partner/src/bridge.ts`, `bridge-out.ts`, `partner.ts`, `render.ts`; `eval/fake-bridge-nmem.ts`, `eval/bridge-live.ts`; `test/bridge-released.test.ts`; `design/bridge.md` "Try it live"; product-model glossary; research/66 §7; todo |

## 2026-11-13: The default is proactive (the author: "默认策略需要有主动 ai 哈")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D250 | **A home that never chose how it hears about things is on 每天最多 3 件 / Up to 3 a day, not 不用主动找我: connecting an account is consent to read it, and restraint lives in what is said (D243), not in whether it looks. The first-add question stays, with its default shown and silence meaning yes. 不再需要 to 早上那条还要吗？ goes to 只说急的 (never off), kept as its reason, and the morning note is offered back once when the notes got materially better. Built 2026-11-13; checked by fake-clock tests and the replay of the day (7/7), not yet live.** *Who:* the fresh user who connects Gmail and never touches a chip (before: nothing ever came, the feature looked absent; after: a morning message with up to 3 things, the chips under it); the consumer who expects dots' "it just tells me"; the developer whose home went quiet after a 不再需要 said to notes that, before D243, couldn't notice his flight. *Feel:* 惊喜 the first morning, 放心 because the first note says how it works and the chips are right there, 好用 because nothing had to be set. *First time:* adding the account; nothing else. (1) **The default.** Settings report `proactive: "three"` with `proactiveBy: "default"` when never chosen; the chip row shows 每天最多 3 件 selected with **你还没选过，先这样：早上把值得说的放在一条里，最多 3 件；急的随时说。 / You haven't chosen yet, so for now: one note each morning with up to 3 things; anything urgent right away.** Settings › 通知 shows the row only once there is an account. (2) **The first add.** The first-look offer stays (§11); watching starts at once (new mail only, from now); the quiet 60-day look back waits half an hour for the offer's answer, so a yes runs the look the person is waiting for first; a choice made elsewhere lets it go at once, silence lets it go after the half hour. What can't wait may be said "now" meanwhile, as on any day. (3) **The cadence question stays** (after the first look, or after Not now), with 每天最多 3 件 already selected; the default is not an answer, any chip is (even the one already on). A home that never saw the question (connected without the offer, or before D250) gets it once, under its first morning message on the default. (4) **不再需要 → 只说急的, kept as `keep_note`.** Chosen over a weekly or "when it matters" morning note: it is what the person literally said; after D243 只说急的 still carries a trip within 30 hours, production maintenance, money that changes tomorrow, a correction, a person who asked again; "anything for me?" is answered from the same finds in every mode; and a new rung would add a fifth chip and a concept for an ambiguous signal (three unread mornings may mean the lock screen was enough). The mode before is kept for the way back. (5) **Offered back once.** `NOTES_REV` (1 = D243) marks a material change in what the notes can notice. A home on 只说急的 whose source is `keep_note`, or unknown with 不再需要 in its Log, and whose rev is older, hears once, the next time the person writes: **现在我能提前告诉你航班、维护、扣费这些了。要每天早上说几件吗？ / I can now tell you about flights, maintenance and billing changes ahead of time. Want a few each morning?** with **好 / Yes** · **不用 / No thanks** (ask `note_again`). No answer keeps 只说急的; 好 restores the mode before (else 每天最多 3 件), 不用 keeps 只说急的; both are a choice, never offered again. A choice in Settings before then cancels it; a mode the person chose is never re-offered. Before D250 the source wasn't kept, so a home that chose 只说急的 in Settings after a 不再需要 hears the one line too (accepted: one line, default hold). (6) **The source is kept from now on:** `proactiveBy` = `default` · `chosen` (any client's chips, a re-offer answered) · `keep_note`. Alternative: keep "silence = nothing watches" and make the first-add question louder (stronger consent, but the fresh user who never answers gets nothing, which is the failure the author named). | the author, 2026-11-13 | `connectors.md` §3, §5, §8, §11, §13, §15; `product-model.md`; `scenarios.md` K6, K15; `docs/accounts.md`, `docs/settings.md`; `todo.md`; `packages/protocol/src/proactive.ts`; `packages/core/src/settings.ts`, `packages/core/src/proactive/engine.ts`; web and Mac chips, `note_again` |

## 2026-11-13: Which phone (the author, from their phone, about their own Pixel Fold; the task said "还是没连上用户的真机：phone 工具这次控制的仍是模拟器")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |

| D251 | **Phone work says which phone: `needs.phone` is `"mine"` (the person's own phone: their apps, accounts, messages), `"ducter"` (Ducter's own clean phone, 用手机), or `"any"` (either; the `true` of before D251 means the same). Work for the person's own phone never falls to Ducter's phone: their Android phone connected without 用这台手机 gets D247's card even where Ducter's phone could do it; 先不用 is told plainly and reports blocked, and may only ask whether Ducter's phone would do. Built 2026-11-13, checked by core tests through the real core and the partner eval (haiku); not yet live on hel.** *What happened (hel, 0.0.48, read-only):* the partner opened `{browse, phone: true}`; the Pixel Fold was paired and connected but not added (Android's switch was on, a separate bug fixed on main the same day: a phone whose switch is on is now added when its app says hello); D247's card appears only when nothing else can serve, and Ducter's emulator on the author's Mac could, so the task drove the emulator ("About emulated device") and reported blocked. *Who:* the consumer who says 用我的手机 and means their WeChat (before: a stranger's phone with none of their accounts, a confusing report; after: their own phone asked for, or one card to turn it on); the developer who says "try our app on Android" (Ducter's clean phone, never their own); the fresh user (unchanged: one card, one switch). *Feel:* 放心, the task never pretends a test phone is theirs. *First time:* they just ask. (1) **The partner picks which** (task_open's `needs.phone`, a string enum): mine for 我的手机, 我的微信, their orders, "on my Pixel"; ducter for 在安卓上试我们的 App, an APK, a fresh phone; any when an app anyone can open does; **unsure: mine** (a wrong mine costs one card; a wrong ducter does the work in an account that isn't theirs). (2) **Routing:** mine: their added phone (D238), else their connected Android phone with the setup card (D247) whatever else exists, else nothing opens (`MINE_NO_PHONE`: install Ducter on their Android phone; Ducter's phone only as a question when the work needs none of their accounts); bound for the task's life, it never falls back; with their phone gone mid-task the tools say so (`HANDSET_MINE_NONE`) and it reports blocked. ducter: Ducter's phone only (D217, D234), never the person's; none: `DUCTER_NO_PHONE` (用手机 on a Mac). any: unchanged (D238, D247). (3) **先不用 / 不借 on mine:** `HANDSET_MINE_NO`: no phone of theirs, report blocked; it may ask, with waiting as the default, whether Ducter's phone would do when the work needs none of their accounts; it never switches by itself. ## 2026-11-13: The book comes back on the Pixel Fold (the author, Android app 0.0.48, home 0.0.49/0.0.50: "为啥我现在 Android 打开 fold 上竟然没有两栏布局了？")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D252 | **On an open foldable the book is always the layout: the conversation left of the fold, On hand (or the task opened beside it) right; the app reads the fold against the page as it is laid out now, and On hand never takes the whole screen on a book.** *Who:* the author on his Pixel Fold, and anyone who opens a foldable from the cover screen. *Feel:* before, unfolding with Ducter open left one 640 column lying across the crease, with no way back but folding again or leaving the app; after, the two sides open like a book every time. Unfolding reports the inner screen's fold while the web view still has the cover screen's width, so the fold seemed to lie past the page's edge and came out as none (`window.ducterFold = null`); nothing read it again once the web view grew. Opening the app already unfolded worked, which is why it was missed. Reproduced on the emulator's Pixel Fold (open on the cover screen, unfold: `ducterFold` null at 841 CSS px). **Fix:** the app keeps Android's fold and reads it against the web view again whenever the web view's size or place changes (`MainActivity.readFold`), so unfolding, turning and resizing all land on the right split; checked: unfold → book, half-open → book, turned while half-open → tabletop, turned flat → one column, upright again → book. (2) **On hand at the whole screen on a book (amends D184 (5), keeps D244):** D216 made the whole-screen On hand one list on a 960 measure, and the book rules for D184's four lanes stopped matching anything, so on a book that list lay across the crease. The book already is On hand beside the conversation, so on a book On hand never takes the whole screen (its arrows are not shown, ⌘2 opens it beside the conversation, `#onhand/full` shows the book). An opened task still can: it stands in the second half with On hand as a rail in the first (D244), and Esc from it goes back to the book. The dead lane rules are gone. *Built 2026-11-13; checked on the Android 16 emulator's Pixel Fold; for the author's check on the Pixel (needs the app from this release: the fix is in the app, not the page).* | U (the author's Pixel Fold) | `apps/android` (`MainActivity.kt`, `CoreTest.kt`), `apps/web/src/fold.ts`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/test/{fold,fill}.test.ts`, `apps/web/demo-onhand.ts` (prints a pair link), `design/{android,ui}.md`, `docs/phone.md` |

## 2026-11-13: The conversation keeps your place, and its words can leave (the author: "发现聊天界面 手机和 app 都不够好：用户不能 copy 消息，不能发现有新消息顺滑到最新，等等……你能第一性原理拉满这里体验么")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D254 | **The conversation does what every messaging app does to keep your place, on the Mac and on the web (so the iPhone, Android and iPad apps): it follows the end while you are at it, stays put when you scroll up, says what came with a count and takes you back in one tap; it opens where the news starts; and every message, code block and link can be copied, on the phone too. Built 2026-11-13 for the author's review.** *Who:* all three people, the same moment: reading back while the partner writes (the developer checking a result while three more arrive), opening the app after a meeting (the consumer), and the fresh user who long-presses a message to copy it as they would in any chat. *Feel:* before, news arrived out of sight and silently, the page jumped when a picture loaded, Copy on the phone did nothing at all over the home network, and a long reply was entered from its bottom; after, nothing moves under your eye, a small pebble says 3 条新消息, one tap lands on the first of them, and Copy says 已拷贝. *How it starts:* nothing to learn; it is how chats behave. (1) **Following the end.** At the end (within 80 pt) the conversation follows: a new row glides up (smooth scroll; MyGo's `FollowEnd` + `FollowAnimation` on the Mac), and anything that grows under a reader at the end (a picture loading, a card, a living message, the phone's keyboard opening: a `ResizeObserver` on the web) keeps the end. Only moving *up* lets go of the end, so a glide never flickers. Sending always goes to the end. (2) **The way back** (`wayBack` / `WayBack`): a clay pebble centred over the composer, the secondary button's clay (rim, seam, 3 pt ledge) with the floating shadow and the arrow drawn in the accent. Round (40 pt) when the reader is more than about a screen up (**回到最新 / Jump to latest**, its accessible name); when the partner said something while the reader was up it widens to **{n} 条新消息 / {n} new messages** (**1 条新消息 / 1 new message**, 99+ past 99; read aloud **回到新消息，{n} 条 / Go to new messages, {n}**). The person's own messages never count. A tap lands on the first new message's top (12 pt of air), or the end when what came fits on the screen: one rule (`landing`). It settles in on the spring (14 pt up from 0.86, one overshoot) and a new count eases up 3 pt; under reduced motion it is simply there. ⌘↓ (Ctrl+↓ off a Mac; End outside a field on the web) goes to the newest. (3) **新消息 / New messages:** when the conversation opens (and, on the web, when the app comes back to the front) a quiet centred line in the accent with hairlines either side stands before the first of the partner's messages not yet read, unless the person wrote after it or the living message's "你不在的时候" already says it; when what came is taller than the screen, the conversation opens on that line, else at the end. Sending takes the line away. (4) **Read means seen:** the conversation counts as read only while its end is in view (and, as before, after 2.5 s in front); news below a reader scrolled up stays unread until they reach it. (5) **The place is kept** when the phone shows On hand or a task and comes back (the web keeps scroll top and following across the conversation leaving the screen; the Mac's list already lived on the app). (6) **Copy.** Long press (touch) or right click: the menu's first line is when it was said (**今天 23:37 / today 23:37**, the time lines' format), then **回复 / Reply**, **拷贝 / Copy** (was 复制: the word Apple's systems, the viewer and the code block already use, D242), on a link **拷贝链接 / Copy link**, and on a touch screen **选择文字 / Select text**: the message's words on a sheet where the system's own selection works, with **全部拷贝 / Copy all** and **完成 / Done**. Copy takes the message *as written* (`copyText`): styling marks out (bold, italic, headings), a link as "words (address)", code and its fences kept; the user's words exactly. The Mac's partner bubbles get the same menu (MyGo's view now shares its selection with the bubble, `ShareSelection`): with words selected, Copy is the selection's. On the web, Copy tries the Clipboard API and falls back to a selected hidden field inside the same tap (the home over plain http has no `navigator.clipboard`, which made Copy a silent no-op before), with a light tap and **已拷贝 / Copied**, or **没能拷贝。用「选择文字」自己选一下。/ Couldn't copy. Use Select text to pick the words yourself.** On a touch screen the bubbles opt out of the system's text selection and callout so the long press is always Ducter's menu (the click that ends a long press never opens the link under it). Every code block in a message (and in a task's transcript on the web) carries a quiet **拷贝 / Copy** at its top right (**已拷贝** for 1.6 s). (7) **The draft survives** the web view being closed (per browser, until sent or cleared). (8) **Not adopted:** editing the last message with ↑ (the partner already acted on it, and the Log is append-only: say a correction instead), read ticks (one partner reads at once; its Presence says it works, D104), reactions. **Later** (todo): find in the conversation, Dynamic Type on the phone, the time on hover on the Mac. (9) Found and fixed on the way: one `}` lost in D248's merge (`.screens-both .both-row`) had nested every later rule of `app.css`, D248's own included, so none applied; a test now checks the stylesheet's blocks close. Alternative not taken: Telegram's always-present round arrow with the unread total; Ducter says only what came while you were reading, and nothing when you are at the end (silence is success). | U (the author, 2026-11-13), research/83 | `apps/web/src/{follow.ts,conv-follow.tsx,conv-copy.ts,i18n-conv.ts,i18n.ts,markdown.ts,reply.tsx,views.tsx,transcript.tsx,app.ts,main.tsx}`, `apps/web/static/{app.css,app.js}`, `apps/web/test/follow.test.ts`, `apps/web/demo-follow.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{i18n/conv.go,i18n/reply.go,views/follow.go,views/follow_test.go,views/conversation.go,views/reply.go,views/app.go}`, `design/{conversation.md,ui.md,product-model.md,scenarios.md,todo.md}`, `docs/getting-started.md`, `research/83-conversation-ux.md` |

## 2026-11-13: The loan's life on the person's own phone (the author's real errand on the Pixel Fold, hel, home 0.0.49–0.0.51: borrow, browse and screenshots worked; hand-over, screen recording and the loan's end never closed)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D253 | **A yes is for one loan: every way a loan of the person's phone ends ends it on the home and the phone, is said to the task once with why, and never comes back by itself; a phone that doesn't answer is said at once; a step that arrives late never runs; locking the phone gives it back; one card is the only ask; their Done is checked; the phone's own switches wait for Go; a task's phone, Ducter's or theirs, is bound for its life and named in every step.** *Who:* the author, a heavy multi-agent developer lending his own Pixel Fold for a long errand, and the consumer user who just wants it to work and to get the phone back. *Feel:* before, the task waited blind 20 s at a time, he had to stop it by hand after locking, and after he stopped it the task was told "you may use Pixel Fold now" while its tools refused; after, the phone is his again the moment he locks it or taps Stop, every surface says the same, and the task says plainly why it can't go on and what to do. *Diagnosis on hel's Log (kinds, states, tool names and errors only):* (a) **the revival** (task ravju9x9, seq 5237–5248): the person's Done re-sent `start` to a phone that had gone quiet; it timed out, Stop came, then the woken page delivered the queued `start`, the phone took the loan again and the home announced it (`lend` checked nothing about Stop, and a hello holding a loan the home didn't have was left alone); (b) **the blind waits** (seq 5107, 5108, 5126, 5215, 5239): every call waited its full 20 s, with no way to tell a locked, closed or offline phone apart; the first run of them began a few seconds after a quick-settings tap turned Wi-Fi on and off (seq 5094–5099: a network change can drop the page's socket silently; inferred, not proven); (c) **two asks** (seq 5054, 5061): the system's card and the task's own question in its report for the same loan; (d) **Done taken as done** (seq 5203, 5237): the person's Done on "start the recorder" was forwarded as "User says Go: Done." and nothing checked it; (e) **which phone** (zz7pad6q, ibg9hk2w, both `needs.phone: true` on the MacBook before D251): the emulator, then the Pixel within the same task once it was added; D251's "mine" closes the first, an "any" task still moved. **(1) The end, everywhere:** Stop (any window, the pill, the notification), Android's switch off and Remove end the loan for the rest of the task; a lock and a lost phone end it, the next tool says so once, and the one after asks again with a new card; the task stopping ends it; moot cards (the person's turn, an open ask) close as not answered. **(2) The beat:** while lent the home calls the phone every 3 s; no answer for 6 s is **暂时没回应 / isn't answering** on the opened task and the phone's card, and every tool says so at once with what can be known (locked, screen off, Android's background limit, not connected) and one next step (end the turn; a message arrives when it answers again, then phone_look first); 15 s quiet or the app gone 3 s ends the loan as lost, and the app ends a loan it heard nothing about for 15 s. **(3) Never late, never revived:** every call carries its deadline; the app refuses a late tap, swipe, key, text, launch or start; a start that answers after Stop lends nothing; a hello showing a loan the home doesn't hold is stopped there; the task is told it may use the phone only after the start and a first read answered. **(4) Locking gives it back:** the app ends the loan the moment the screen goes off (checked every second; Android's own broadcast came ~15 s late on the emulator), refuses to start on a locked phone, and the pill keeps the screen on while lent, so the phone never locks itself while the task thinks. **(5) One ask, a checked Done:** the tools' answers and the brief say the card is the only ask; the person's Done is forwarded as their word, and the task checks with phone_look before going on. **(6) Screen recording is the person's step for now:** one card says exactly what (quick settings, Screen record, no audio, Start), the task checks it is recording and, at the end, that the video is there with its length before saying it was recorded; a recorder of Ducter's own (MediaProjection with its own consent) is a later slice (`todo.md`). **(7) The phone's own switches:** in quick settings (by name) and on a switch in Settings, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, airplane mode, mobile data, hotspot, location, NFC, VPN and Do not disturb wait for Go; a tap there at an unnamed place is refused. **(8) Which phone, for life:** a task's phone is bound at its first phone tool, Ducter's phone as much as the person's (no move either way, whatever is added or removed later), and every step's answer ends with which phone it ran on. *Built 2026-11-13: home (core, protocol, web page relay and the quiet line, the brief), Android app (bridge 2); checked through the real core with a fake phone that goes quiet, wakes with queued steps, locks and ends loans (`handset-life.test.ts`), and on an Android 16 emulator: a late tap and a late start refused, the lock ending the loan and its notification within a second of the screen going off, a loan with no word for 17 s ended as lost, the pill holding the screen on for 30 s at a 10 s timeout (`mHoldScreenWindow`) and the screen sleeping after the loan. For the author's real-phone check (`todo.md`).* | U (the author's retro of four real errands on hel) | `packages/core/src/handset/index.ts`, `packages/core/src/android/{index,tools,gate}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{ws,decisions,core}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/{handset,index}.ts`, `packages/runner/src/brief.ts`, `apps/web/src/{handset.tsx,i18n-handset.ts}`, `apps/android` (`Handset.kt`, `HandsetLife.kt`, `HandsetPill.kt`, `Notify.kt`, `HandsetLifeTest.kt`), `packages/core/test/{handset-life,handset,handset-which,android-phone}.test.ts`, `design/{use-this-phone,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/phone.md` |

(2) **The mark:** Ducter's own, not a stock arrow: the one drawn chevron (D213's open angle, round ends) pointing back, on a single line that sweeps back from below; a 16-unit grid at a 1.8 stroke, like the chevron; the same paths in the pebble, the swipe, the menu, the composer and 回复这段 (web `REPLY_PATHS`, Mac `drawReply`). On hel the task's last steps answered (16:18:32 and 16:18:40 with Chrome in front, a picture at 16:19:01), it ended its turn at 16:19:13, and at 16:19:41.518 a hello reported the loan gone and 3 ms later "Pixel Fold is back" [VERIFIED, Log seq 5754–5771: both tells came from one hello, the code path that said "lost" and then "back" in the same call]. Whether the page was paused or its socket died on a network change can't be told from the Log [INFERRED: both are failures of a page link; the app ended it 15 s after the last beat it saw]. The overnight "stopped answering" at 22:26:00 was not a new failure but the 16:19 loss said again by the next tool six hours later [VERIFIED, seq 6267: same task, same text, no loan in between], and its "Don't retry" made the task give up instead of asking for a new loan. (2) **The recordings stopped at the task's `phone_open_app`** both times [VERIFIED, Log seq 5615 and 5646: no tap, key or swipe between the person starting the recorder and the stop; the pictures before the opens still showed the timer]. On an Android 16 emulator Android's recorder offers **录制单个应用 / Record one app** first, and a single-app recording of Ducter kept going when Chrome was opened by the shell and by Ducter's own bridge [VERIFIED, `dumpsys media_projection`], so the stop is not reproduced off the Pixel [INFERRED: the Pixel's own recorder or the person's hand; no tap of ours was involved]. (3) **"Opened" was the launch call returning**, not the app in front [VERIFIED, code: `ok` right after `startActivity`, then a fixed 1.2 s sleep]. (4) **The end reason was a guess** from the last hello [VERIFIED, code: `whyQuiet`]. **(1) A native link while lent** (`HandsetLink.kt`, bridge 3): the loan's `start` starts `HandsetLinkService` (a foreground service; Android allows it from the background because the bound accessibility service keeps Ducter at BFGS [VERIFIED on the emulator: "Background started FGS: Allowed … uidState: BFGS"]), which opens its own WebSocket (OkHttp, the device's token from the page's hello, in memory only), says `hello` with `client: "handset"` (never live: no conversation, no presence) and `handset_hello` with `link: "native"`, answers `handset_req` itself, and reconnects with backoff 0.5–8 s. Type `specialUse` (no other fits: connectedDevice is for Bluetooth/USB/NFC peripherals, dataSync is time-limited on Android 15+), plus `mediaProjection` while recording; Doze never sets in while lent because the pill keeps the screen on. The home prefers the native link, keeps the page's as the fallback (used at once when the native one drops), and leaves the page's hellos alone while the native one is up. D253's rules stand: a lock gives it back, Stop ends it, nothing revives a loan. **(2) Why, once, with an epoch:** the app says `boot` (its process's run), `gen` (its link's connection count) and why it ended: `network` (its own link had been up and was down 15 s), `lost` (no beat), `locked`, `stop`, `service`; the home says the cause in words (the phone's network; Android closed the app: a hello from a new run holding no loan; the page paused; the app's connection gone; quiet). A loss reported by a hello is said once as "ended … its app answers again now", with no "back" after it; otherwise "back" only on a later hello and after the phone answered a call. The next tool repeats a loss only within 2 minutes; later it just asks with a new card. **(3) Ducter records the screen:** `phone_record_start` (task tools; the partner's tools unchanged) opens Android's own dialog over the app in front (Android 14+: the whole screen only, `MediaProjectionConfig.createConfigForDefaultDisplay`, so opening another app never ends or blanks it); the task is blind meanwhile, and a task's tap on that dialog is refused (only the person answers it). Then H.264, long edge ≤ 1280, 1.5 Mbit/s, no sound, at most 8 minutes, saved in the phone's Movies/Ducter, the pill showing a red dot and **在录屏 / Recording the screen** (the notification too). `phone_record_stop` stops it, the app sends the file to `POST /api/handset/recording` (that phone's token, for a recording the home asked for), and the home checks it (an MP4 by its header, the size the phone said, its length from the movie header) and keeps it in the task's evidence; only then does the tool say "saved and checked" with its length, size and path for `show` (a video up to 100 MB, `MEDIA_LIMITS.video`, plays in the file viewer). A lock, Stop or a lost loan stops it cleanly; what was recorded comes back marked partial and the task is told. The brief says to use these and never to ask the person to start Android's recorder; on Ducter's own phone there is no recorder yet (pictures instead). **(4) Verified open:** `phone_open_app` answers "opened; it is in front" only when that package is in front within 3 s, else says what is in front and not to take it as opened (both phones). **(5) The recorder's controls are the person's:** in System UI a tap on the recorder's tile, its chip or Stop (recording or sharing) waits for Go like a switch (`toggleOf` → `record`). *Alternatives:* keep the page link and only lengthen the beat (rejected: a paused page answers nothing however long the home waits); a link always on whenever Use this phone is (rejected for now: a permanent notification between loans for nothing the person asked); `adb screenrecord` or Android's recorder driven by taps (rejected: needs debugging, or taps on the person's consent). *Built 2026-11-14 (bridge 3): home (handsets: native link, causes, the back rule, the stale loss, recording; ws `client: "handset"`; the upload route; the media video limit; the gate; tools; the brief), Android app (`HandsetLink.kt`, `Recorder.kt`, `Handset.kt`, `HandsetPill.kt`, `Notify.kt`, manifest, OkHttp 4.12.0), web relay (network, native). ## 2026-11-16: why the proactive AI went quiet on hel, and the trial that wrote into the real conversation (the author: "我发现我们的 ducter 的主动 ai 还是没有新的消息给我你能查查是真的没有消息还是有问题"; "我在 ducter 里收到这俩，是你在测试 bridge 功能还是？")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D258 | **A reply to a find is the person engaging, never a "not now"; bars learned under the old rule are relearned once from the Log; a 只说急的 set before D250 hears the morning note offered back once; a Bridge trial never shares a mailbox with a live home.** *Who:* the author, on hel since 2026-11-10. *Found (hel, counts only, 2026-11-16):* the watchers read normally (gmail 41 items, calendar 129 on 11-15; Slack had no mentions since 11-14, checked through oo); the home was on 只说急的, written 11-10 by pre-D250 code (no `proactiveBy`), so no morning note was ever made (0 mornings) and every non-urgent keep (two security alerts and a production notice the judge kept on 11-14/15) was held as not urgent; five "now" notes went out 11-12..14, then nothing; and the `waiting_on_you` bar stood at 60, raised because a decision resolved as `reply` (the person writing back, or a message that answered the card) counted as ignored, the same as 先等等. (1) **Reply is neutral.** `decision_resolved` with `reply` passes the find (`find_state: passed`) and moves no bar; only Go (down) and Not now (up) teach. (2) **Relearn once** (`BARS_REV` 1): bars and the ignored list are rebuilt from the Log's own Go/Not now on finds; a find held by a reply becomes passed. (3) **`NOTES_REV` 2:** a home on 只说急的 with no `proactiveBy` (set before D250, when the note couldn't see a flight) is treated like 不再需要: the next time the person writes, the partner offers the morning note back once (D250's note_again; either answer is a choice). A mode chosen in Settings after D250 is never re-offered. (4) **The trial:** `bridge:live --connected --real` ran as the persona's real identity while hel's Ducter was connected as the same identity, so two trial requests became cards in the author's conversation. The preflight now stops when another active connection reads that mailbox (`--share-mailbox` to allow). (5) **Copy:** a request from an own agent Mem doesn't name read 你的 another agent; it reads 你的另一个 AI / your other AI agent (web and Mac). Tradeoff: one more offer line for an author who did choose 只说急的 once; the alternative, switching hel to 每天最多 3 件 silently, overrides a choice. | the author, 2026-11-16 | `packages/core/src/proactive/engine.ts`; `packages/partner/eval/bridge-live.ts`; `apps/web/src/views.tsx`; `apps/desktop/internal/views/peers.go` |

## 2026-11-16: any file, sent as naturally as a picture (the author: "我们的 ducter 仅仅支持图片上传应该还是太傻了，应该支持所有文件格式才自然？")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D259 | **Built 2026-11-16 with fakes (web, Mac, core, partner, runner, worker); not yet tried on a real iPhone, Android or with a real model reading a file. D206's phase 2: the person sends any file the way they send a picture (paste, drop, the one button), it shows in their own bubble as the file card and opens in the D239 viewer, and the partner and tasks can actually use it.** *Who:* the developer hands over a log, a script, a CSV or a design doc; the consumer forwards a PDF, a contract, a spreadsheet, the way they would in WeChat or iMessage; the fresh user picks "Choose File" in the phone's own menu and expects it to go. *Feel:* before, **现在只能发图片** said no to the most ordinary thing a messaging app does (a broken promise); after, it simply goes, it is answered from (好用, 顺滑), and nothing in it can run (放心). *First time:* no new step: the button that was **添加图片** is now **添加图片或文件 / Add images or files**, the phone's sheet already offered Files, a drop or ⌘V of a file already landed on the composer. (1) **One button, one tray.** Everything picked, pasted or dropped goes in: a picture the device can read is made ready as before (D206: scaled, EXIF gone); anything else goes as it is, unchanged (no canvas, nothing stripped), and so does a picture the device can't read (a HEIC on the Mac, a TIFF in Chrome). In the tray a file is a wider clay tile: its drawn kind over its name; in the person's bubble, the file card with its ring until it lands, then the card itself (打开 / Open into the viewer, D239). Up to 10 things per message (**一次最多 10 个**). The Mac's panel offers every file; ⌘V of files copied in Finder adds those files (before the pasteboard's picture, which is their icon). (2) **The home keeps any file** (`POST /api/media`, `sniffSent`): a picture by its bytes; a kind Ducter shows by its name and bytes (`FILE_TYPES`, `TEXT_EXTS`); otherwise text when its first 8 KB is UTF-8 with no NUL (a Dockerfile; a `.env` the person chose to send: theirs to send, unlike a task's, D239); otherwise `application/octet-stream` (`ANY_FILE`): inert bytes, stored as `<sha256>.bin`, served only with `nosniff`, the sandboxing CSP and its own name, never run, never a page. The Mac never hands such a file to macOS to open (opening can run it): **这种文件在 Ducter 里不会打开，只原样存着。存一份，用你自己的应用看。** with Save a copy only; the web says the same. (3) **The limit: 50 MB a file** (`MEDIA_LIMITS.file`), pictures stay at 25 MB (they are scaled first). Why 50: a From-anywhere home sits behind Cloudflare, whose free plan refuses a request body over 100 MB (D228); Bun's default cap is 128 MB; the home holds one upload in memory while it hashes and stores it; 50 MB covers nearly every document, deck, log and archive a person hands a partner (a model reads a few hundred KB of it at most), and a phone on mobile data sends it in about a minute. Said before a byte leaves when the client can see it, and on a 413: **这个文件太大了：每个最多 50 MB / That file is too big: up to 50 MB each**. (4) **The partner uses it.** Its line names each file: id, name, kind in words, size and where it is on the home under its own name (`media/named/<id12>/<name>`, a hard link: no second copy): `[with a file: file 3f2a91c04b7e "季度报告.pdf" (PDF, 2.1 MB) at …/季度报告.pdf. Read it with your file tools when the message needs it (a long one in parts). A task that needs it gets it by id in task_open's or task_send's media. Never say a path to the user]`. A text, Markdown or CSV file of at most 6,000 characters comes along whole in the line (no round trip); a longer one or a PDF it reads there with its own read-only tool (Claude Code's Read takes PDFs by its own docs and is capped at 8K tokens a read, principle 5; Codex, pi and DSH read with theirs, a PDF only where the machine has a reader: INFERRED, not yet run with a real model). Files are never image input. The persona and the tool descriptions are unchanged (the line says what to do), so no new eval run. (5) **A task gets it.** `task_open`/`task_send` media take a file's id as they take a picture's (none named: the latest message's go with the brief, as before); the runner adds one line to the turn naming each file, its kind, size and path, and that it is a copy (changes go in the task's own folder). Any agent reads it, pictures or not. On a worker, the bytes go down with the words, the worker keeps them in `media-in/files/<id12>/<name>` and the line names its own path, never the home's. (6) **Pictures unchanged:** the same preparing, grid, viewer, image input and lines. *Tradeoff:* a file is sent as it is, so whatever is inside it (a document's author, a photo inside a deck) goes too, said in the user page; the alternative, cleaning every kind, isn't possible in general. *Kept for later:* a partner that reads PDFs as a model's own document input through OAR, PDF text on the home for agents without a PDF reader, the share sheet into Ducter, and whether the composer's picture mark should become a mark for both (todo). | U (the author, 2026-11-16), L | `packages/protocol/src/{media,internal}.ts`; `packages/core/src/{media,ws}.ts`; `packages/partner/src/{render,partner}.ts`; `packages/runner/src/{runner,remote,worker-host}.ts`; `apps/web/src/{media,media-up,media-keys,app,reply,fileview,i18n,i18n-fileview}.ts(x)`, `apps/web/static/app.css`; `apps/desktop/{mediahands.go,internal/{media/upload.go,views/media.go,views/fileview.go,protocol/media.go,i18n/i18n.go,i18n/fileview.go}}`; `apps/android/.../Pictures.kt` (comment); tests (`core/test/media.test.ts`, `partner/test/media.test.ts`, `runner/test/{media,worker}.test.ts`, `apps/web/test/media.test.ts`, Go `TestSendAnyFile`, `TestUploadShape`); `design/{media,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`; `docs/{pictures,README}.md` |

| D261 | **Built 2026-11-16 (the Mac app, the web client, core), for the author's review. Projects are a lens, never something to manage; the board always reads by state under a strip of four counts that are also its filters; a wait always says what it waits for and when it looks again; what has gone quiet for a day and what you have already seen fold away; what needs you takes no room when there is none.** *Who:* the heavy developer with 20 to 50 tasks across hawdb, mem and ducter plus errands, who has to answer at a glance what is stuck, which project is moving and what got done today (Conductor's sidebar of workspaces is the reference); the consumer whose tasks are a hotel, a recording, a review, all of no folder, who must never see "project" as a concept; the fresh user with one errand, who sees one row and a calm sentence and nothing else (no column, no strip filter to learn: four numbers, one of them 1). *Feel:* before, a by-state list that looked the same with 4 tasks or 40: three waits from two days ago sat beside a fresh one with no words under them, an empty 等你 card took the top, the Mac and web said 下一件事 where they meant 接下来, and opening a stale wait showed its title again. After, a glance answers the three questions: the column says per project whether anything needs you (the partner's flag), works (reading) or came back new (smiling), and what its branches changed (+a −d, unmerged); the strip says 2 · 14 · 5 · 10; quiet waits sit folded under one line, 还有 3 件，一天多没有动静, and each says what it waited for, or plainly 停下了，没说在等什么. *First time:* zero setup. A task with a folder is in that folder's project; one without is in 其他 / Other; the column appears only at two groups. (1) **Projects, as a lens (answering the author: yes, but never managed).** A group is a task's `project`, else its folder's name, else **其他 / Other** (kept from D128: honest for work and life errands alike; 生活 would mislabel a review of an org's PRs, 零碎 and 杂事 judge the work). Projects added by hand (D186) stand in it before their first task. On the Mac at 1100 pt and up (the rail's own threshold) and on the web from ROOMY (1120 px) it is a **column at the left of the board** on the deeper ground: **全部 / All** on top, each project, Other last; a row is the name, under it the unmerged **+a −d** of its tasks' branches (only where there are branches), then **one status place**, the partner's own face for its most urgent task (needs you > working > new result, D244's rule and art), then its count. Narrower (and on the phone) the same entries are **one row of names** that scrolls sideways inside the page, the working face left out. The choice is kept per device. Under a project: its tasks only, its routines (D185) and, for one added by hand with neither, **还没有事。/ Nothing here yet.**; **在这儿新建 / New task here** sits at the strip's end. What belongs to no task (the partner's own asks, task-less waits, calls) shows under All and Other. **Not taken:** status dots in the column (D69, D73: a face, never a dot); a project as an object to create, rename or archive (a label, product-model §Project); branches as rows of the column (Conductor's tree; Ducter's rows are tasks, the branch is in the task). (2) **One rail at a time.** Opening a task turns the board into D244's rail, narrowed by the same lens, its head naming the lens (**全部 / All** or the project), which goes back to the board; ⌘⇧] walks the lens's tasks. The column never stands beside the rail: two left columns would fight over one job. (3) **The strip:** **等你 · 在做 · 在等 · 今天做完** as four counts (the number large, the word under it), within the lens. Pressed, a count narrows the board to that state; pressed again, or Esc, lets go; a count of none is quiet and does nothing. It replaces D128's **按状态 / 按项目** toggle and D216 (8)'s By project grouping: the lens and the strip are the two axes, and a toggle between two layouts of one list was a thing to learn. (4) **What needs you takes no room when there is none**: no empty 等你 card; one calm sentence opens the board instead (**现在没有要你定的事。Ducter 在做 14 件，做完会告诉你。**). The window header's counts are the shell's (left as they are). (5) **A wait always says what it waits for** (the row's second line and the opened task's headline, both): the waiter's reason; else the state's reason; else the first line of what the task last reported; else **停下了，没说在等什么 / Stopped without saying what it waits for** (true, and the one thing worth a look). Beside it, when it looks again with a 12-point ring of the interval gone by (**11:39 再看一次 / looks again at 11:39**, a timer **… 接着做 / goes on at …**), the day said only when it isn't today. (6) **Quiet waits fold.** A wait whose card and looks haven't changed for 24 hours goes under one line at the end of 在等, **还有 3 件，一天多没有动静 / 3 more, quiet for over a day**, unfolded with a tap; its rows recede and say **上次有动静是 2 天前 / last change 2 d ago**. Automatic, not a verb: the lead's proposed 收起 would be one more thing to manage, and a quiet wait unfolds by itself the moment anything changes. (7) **Done today folds what you've seen.** New results (D244) stay rows; the rest, with missed waits and ended calls, sit under **还有 9 件，你都看过了 / 9 more you've seen**, unfolded with a tap and kept per device. Pressing 今天做完 in the strip shows them all. (8) **Rows say where, not who.** The second line's right end is the project (only under All, from two groups) and the computer (with two or more, D157); the branch and the agent left the row (they are in the opened task; "Claude Code" on every row was noise). Times past a day and a half say days (**2 天前**, never **61 小时前**). (9) **The opened task, conclusion first:** a waiting task's headline is (5)'s words, never its title again, and under it one line: since when it has been quiet and when it looks again (**上次有动静是 3 天前 · 11:39 再看一次**). **Deterministic sources only:** the waiter's reason and times, the state's reason, the task's last report, the latest step in D210's words. (10) **At the source:** a task's `wait_for` is refused when its reason reads as an agent's notes (two or more words glued to numbers, "mentions7", "45minwait"; units and versions don't count; a heuristic from one live case, kept narrow) or when its check only reads the clock (`date`, `sleep`): "wait on the condition itself and set everyMinutes". ## 2026-11-16: a server is not assumed to be on the public internet (the author: Tailscale and similar private networks as a first-class way)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D265 | **Built 2026-11-16 (the CLI), for the author's review; checked with a fake `tailscale`, not on a real tailnet. A server's way to be reached is a choice, Tailscale or your own domain; nothing assumes a public IP or open ports** (research/86). *Who:* the heavy developer whose boxes sit only in a tailnet (no public port, often no domain), and the consumer who was told "use Tailscale" by a friend; a fresh user meets it as one line with one command. *Feel:* before, the install ended with "point a domain at this server's public IP", the wrong instruction for a private server, and the only way around it was an SSH tunnel that leaves the phone out. After, a server already in a tailnet is told so by name, and one command makes Ducter its HTTPS address there. (1) **`ducter tailscale`** (and `--remove`), shaped like `ducter domain`: Ducter answers locally (starting the service if installed); the CLI is found (PATH, or the Mac app's); `tailscale status --json` must say `Running` with a `Self.DNSName`; `CertDomains` must hold that name, else it names the admin console's DNS page (MagicDNS and HTTPS Certificates) before `serve` could block on its interactive flow; 443 on that name must be free or already Ducter's; then `tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:<port>` (access denied → `sudo tailscale set --operator=$USER`); waits for `https://<name>/health` (502–504 fails; no answer from the machine itself only warns, since its DNS may skip MagicDNS while devices in the tailnet can open it); writes `public-url`; pairs. `--remove` turns 443 off only when it forwards to this Ducter, and clears `public-url` only when it is a `ts.net` address; `ducter domain --remove` now leaves a `ts.net` address alone. The runner is injectable (`TailscaleSys`). (2) **What's next never assumes a public IP.** `ducter pair` on a server with no address (so also the end of `service install` and of the installer) leads with `ducter tailscale` when the machine is in a tailnet; otherwise it lists `ducter anywhere`, the domain, Tailscale, then the SSH tunnel. `pair --json` carries `tailnet` and a `tailscale` step. The "a phone can't reach this" and worker lines name both. (3) **Trust unchanged:** served requests keep the ts.net Host and add `X-Forwarded-*` and `Tailscale-User-Login`, so they are remote and need a paired device (test added); tailnet identity adds to pairing, never replaces it. (4) **Clients and push:** the Mac connect card and the iPhone app take a `*.ts.net` address as any other (Go test added); the phone must be in the same tailnet; iPhone and Web Push go out from the home, so they still work. *Not taken:* `tailscale funnel` (public; the opposite of what this user wants); reading tailnet identity as a login (D54's device keys stay the gate); a status probe per address on Devices (todo). *Defaults the author may revisit:* Tailscale led with only when already running; 45 s wait. | U (the author, 2026-11-16), D46, D54, D228, research/86 | `packages/cli/src/{tailscale,domain,remote,main,args,home,i18n}.ts`, `packages/cli/test/{tailscale,remote,home}.test.ts`, `packages/core/test/auth.test.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/remote/remote_test.go`, `scripts/install.sh`; `design/{system.md,roadmap.md,todo.md,product-model.md,scenarios.md,build-and-run.md}` (A14), `docs/{install.md,phone.md,devices.md,troubleshooting.md}`, research/86 |
