| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D341 | **Built 2026-11-17 with fakes only (a fake gh with an in-memory GitHub, scratch vaults); nothing read from or written to the author's GitHub, vault or Mem; the web checked in headless Chrome against `apps/web/demo-todos.ts` on 7999 (zh and en, light and dark, 1400 and 390); the Mac's pane and chip by the Mac test renderer; not reviewed by the author, not on a phone or a real vault.** *Who:* the heavy developer (issues assigned across repos, the PR link pasted back by hand), the consumer (a vault of Obsidian to-dos), the fresh user (meets nothing until something is added). *Feel:* 好用 one sentence ("接 #12") or one pick; 放心 nothing outside starts work, nothing reaches a shared tracker without a Go or a standing go they said yes to, every write in Done for you; 惊喜 the line ticks itself, the PR link lands in the issue. *First time:* Settings › 待办来源 offers GitHub when the home's gh is signed in (D272) and each vault Obsidian itself lists there, one 加上 each; or the person just asks and the partner reads (asking is the consent to read). **(1) One owner per field, no two-way sync.** The outside app owns what the to-do is (title, body, labels, assignee, due, priority) and whether it is open; Ducter owns how it gets done (the task, session, reports, branch, PR). An edit there is told to the running task; closed there while it works: the task is told and one card asks **{label} 在 {app} 上关掉了。这件事停下吗？** (Go 停下, Hold 接着做, Stop by default after 30 min: reversible); reopened or gone: told, the chip says so. Ducter never writes its own state to the app; a comment carries the result once. **(2) In: offered, never started by itself.** The partner's `todos` tool (list, take, write), listed while a source is on or the home's gh is signed in; New task's **从待办里选 / Pick from your to-dos** (a to-do with a live task opens that task); per source **新的来了 / When a new one comes**: **告诉我** (GitHub's default; at most once per source per 3 h), **不用说** (Obsidian's default), **直接接下**: the standing go, offered once X2's way after two takes from that source in 14 days (**以后 GitHub 上标给你的，直接接下？** / **直接接下** / **仍然先问我**), at most 5 a day. A to-do's text reaches the task fenced as outside text, never instructions. **(3) Out: GitHub behind a Go, Obsidian by itself.** GitHub (shared, seen by others): the partner drafts one comment in the issue's own language with the PR link (an English issue gets no Chinese comment: the tool refuses), core makes the card **在 {repo}#{n} 下留言？** with the comment whole (Go **留言** or **留言并关掉** when it fully resolves it, Hold **暂不留言**); after two Go'd comments in 14 days, once: **以后在 GitHub 上做完的，直接留言？**; under it closing still asks (**关掉 {repo}#{n}？**) unless the person chose **留言并关掉** in Settings. Every comment is signed "Written with Ducter". Obsidian (local, their own): **勾掉 / Tick it off** by default when the task is done (`[x]` and ` ✅ date`, as the Tasks plugin writes), **先问我** and **不动它** one tap away; a repeating line is never ticked here. Each write is a `source_write` event with its Go or standing go, shown in Done for you (comment: sent; close, tick: changed). **(4) The Obsidian write.** One line in place (the same file), found by 🆔, `^block` id or its words' hash, after a compare-and-swap on bytes and mtime; refused while a sync conflict copy is beside it, the file is evicted to iCloud, it changed in the last 3 s, or the line isn't open; BOM, line endings and last newline kept. **(5) Where it shows.** Settings › **待办来源 / To-do sources** (the name: research/126 §6, 216 haiku runs; its own clay art owed); the chip (the app's own mark, `repo#12` or the note's name, opening it in its app; **已留言 / 已关掉 / 已勾掉 / 已不在** apart) on the opened task's meta line, On hand's cards, New task's pick and the card; On hand read by source under **来自 / From** in the lens. **(6) Adapters.** `SourceAdapter` (status, list, get, write, ops) holds no consent; Jira and a company's own tracker are adapters later (`todo.md`). Polling, not webhooks: no public address; GitHub every 2 min ETag'd (unchanged looks are free), a bound to-do every 5 min while its task is live. *Tradeoff:* the partner drafts the comment, so its wording varies (the card shows it whole before Go); one GitHub source per home (the home's gh account). *Alternative not taken:* two-way consistency (mirroring Ducter's state into labels, assignee or status): every state change would be a write teammates see, each team needs conventions, and two owners per field need conflict rules; or the outside app as Ducter's task store (a task without an outside to-do then has no home). | issue wey-gu/ducter#6 and the author's reply on two-way sync; research/126 (named comparison in `research/private/126`); D163/D170 (X2's standing go), D191, D272, D291, D300, D314 | `design/{task-sources,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/to-do-sources.md`; `packages/protocol/src/{task-sources,index}.ts`; `packages/core/src/task-sources/`, `packages/core/src/{registry,core,ws,did}.ts`, `packages/core/test/{task-sources,task-sources-bind}.test.ts`, `packages/core/test/fake-gh-issues.ts`; `packages/partner/src/{partner,render,place}.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/{scenarios,run}.ts`, `packages/partner/test/{tool-budget.test,fingerprint}.ts`; `apps/web/src/{todos.tsx,i18n-todos.ts,brand/obsidian.svg,brand/jira.svg}` and the views using them, `apps/web/demo-todos.ts`; `apps/desktop/internal/` (the pane, chip, pick, lens, card) |
## 2026-11-17: the Android app offers a failed update again, says why with a way through the browser, and Settings checks for it (D342; the author's phone, decided by the lead. D342 may be taken by a branch in flight: renumber at merge if so)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D342 | **Built 2026-11-17 with unit tests only; not walked on a phone (the live check is in `todo.md`).** *Who:* the consumer on an Android phone whose network reaches GitHub badly (many in mainland China), and the developer who updates every release. *Felt before:* the app offered an update, the download from GitHub broke off, and opening the app again never offered it; Settings had no way to ask (the author, on a real phone). *Cause, in code:* the quiet check waited an hour from the check that *found* the version, whether or not it was installed (`lastCheck` stamped on success); a step stuck mid-way (a hung connection, Android's install dialog left behind) left the state busy, and a quiet check ran only from idle; the only manual check was the icon's long-press menu. *After (放心, 顺滑):* **(1)** The version offered is kept until it is installed; while it waits and wasn't put off with **以后再说** on the offer, opening the app asks again at once, and back in front after 10 minutes. Closing a failure puts nothing off. **(2)** A step silent for 3 minutes is stuck; the next quiet check starts over, and the stuck step can no longer speak or install. **(3)** A download that stops short is a connection failure, not a checksum one. **(4)** The failure card names the version and says why in one plain sentence, with **再试一次**, **以后再说** and, when GitHub is unreachable or the file broke, **在浏览器里下载** (the website's download page at Android: the same file, the browser's own connection and resume; installing over keeps everything). | D351 | **A to-do source's count is never a guess (the 0.0.75 "0 件没做完" on hel, 2026-11-18).** *Who:* anyone with GitHub connected; the heavy developer saw it (50+ issues assigned, the pane said 0). *Cause:* the home's gh runner kept only the last 8000 characters of gh's output; `gh api -i /issues` prints its status line first and ~700 KB of issues after it, so the status line and the blank line were cut off, the body read as "", "" was taken as an empty list, and the look counted as good (`seen: []` saved). *Now:* (1) gh's stdout is kept whole (stderr's tail is enough); (2) the GitHub list takes only a whole 200 answer that is a JSON list: anything else is a failed look with its reason, never "nothing assigned"; (3) gh is always given HOME (the user's home folder when the home was started without one, a root service), since its sign-in lives under it; (4) a count shows only after a look that read the list: before one, **正在看… / Looking…** (a source says `looking` while a look runs); a failed look says **没能读到 {app}。 / Couldn't read {app}.**, gh's reason as its own line, and **再试一次 / Try again** (asks for the sources again, which looks); (5) a source saved empty with no first look learned (`learned`, new) learns its items quietly on the next look, so a fixed home doesn't announce 50 "new" at once; (6) **the count is the true total**: the list stays one page of the 50 most recent (offering, "new", the seen bookkeeping), and the number is GitHub search's `total_count` over the same scope (`assignee:{login} is:open archived:false`, the filters as `repo:`/`label:`; 557, not 50). GitHub's `incomplete_results`, or search refused with a full page, shows **至少 {n} 件没做完 / At least {n} open**, never a plain number; (7) **PRs waiting for your review** are counted apart (`review-requested:{login} is:open is:pr`), **{n} 个 PR 等你 review / {n} PRs waiting for your review**, a count only: they aren't assigned, so they aren't offered or taken (the source line "标给 {login} 的 issue 和 PR" stays true: assigned PRs are in `/issues?filter=assigned`). | A (the live bug) | `packages/protocol/src/{git-login,task-sources}.ts`, `packages/core/src/task-sources/{adapter,github,index}.ts`, `packages/core/test/{task-sources-look.test.ts,gh-issues-sample.ts,fake-gh-issues.ts}`, `apps/web/src/{todos.tsx,i18n-todos.ts}`, `apps/web/test/todos-count.test.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/sources.go,i18n/todos.go,views/todos.go,views/todos_test.go}`, `design/task-sources.md` |

## 2026-11-18: a report is written for the person; a checkpoint is the task's own note and never shows (D349; the author showed a live Codex watcher on nowledge-co whose reports and saved progress read "Round58完成…16checks15success1preuninstallrunning…". D349 and D350 may be held by branches in flight: may need renumbering at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D349 | **Built 2026-11-18, checked with fakes (a fake run of a watcher, both transcript ports on one fixture, the web at wide and 390 in zh, `.shots/report-words/`); no live model rerun yet.** *Who:* all three, the heavy developer most (a review loop left running all day). *Felt, before:* the task page and On hand read like a machine's ledger (round numbers, queue and ledger file names, counters glued to words) and every round said the whole state again; 放心 and 好用 both broken. *After:* each round is a plain line or two in the person's language, a round that found nothing is one line, and where it saved its progress is a quiet **保存了进度**. **The cause, as found:** nothing in Ducter strips spaces. The report path only trims and cuts (`normalizeReport`), the checkpoint path only cuts at 4,000, the transcript only clips and hides keys, and the web's autospace only adds a U+2005 between Han and Latin. The same checkpoint keeps one space ("lockedmetadata regenerated") while gluing "5requests4mentions", which no mechanical rule does, and the agent's own messages in the same session are spaced normally. The words were the model's: Codex (gpt-5.5) wrote its checkpoints as a compressed ledger for itself, because the brief told it its context is small and its last checkpoint is what it carries on from (and hands that checkpoint back after each compaction, so each round copies the last one's shape); the transcript then showed every checkpoint as the agent's words (D152 (4)); and the report rules asked for the outcome first but set no bar against bookkeeping, no "only what changed", and nothing for a round that found nothing. (1) **The bar for a report** (in the task brief; `report_to_main`'s `summary` says only "For the user, result first", since the task tools sit at their 9.2K budget; runner-side only, so no partner eval): written for the person, in their language; the result first in one plain sentence, then at most a few short lines; ordinary spacing, numbers with their units ("16 项检查，15 项通过", never "16checks15success"); none of the task's own bookkeeping (round numbers, counters, ledger or note file names, ids, hashes) unless the person needs one to act; only what changed since the last report; work that repeats and found nothing new says so in one short line ("nowledge-co 没有新的待审 PR"). (2) **A crammed summary goes back once:** two or more runs of letters and digits glued in turns (`gluedRuns`: at least 10 characters, four groups, or three starting with a digit; never a hash, path, URL, version or identifier) return "Not sent yet…" with the bar, nothing logged; the second try goes as it is, never a loop. No mechanical re-spacing: it would break names like f098, x86_64 or gpt-5.5. (3) **A checkpoint is the task's own note:** the brief and the tool say so (the user doesn't read it; never copy it into a summary; still plain sentences). In the opened task its words never show: it marks the words the agent just said **保存了进度** (when nothing came between, or they are the same words), else it is that line alone, a run of them in a row one line (protocol block `saved`, both ports, `fixtures/transcript.json`); the session index counts it as one line. On hand never quotes it (it reads steps and words only). The CLI's `ducter tail` still prints it: the terminal is where the heavy developer reads everything. (4) **A progress report stays in the transcript** even when it is the latest (only an outcome is said above the transcript): before, a working watcher's newest report showed nowhere on its page. *Alternative not taken:* show a checkpoint folded behind a tap (keeps the note one tap away, but it is written for the agent and adds a control to every save). | U (the live task, 2026-11-18), A | `packages/runner/src/{brief,tools}.ts`, `packages/runner/test/{report-words.test.ts,__snapshots__/runner.test.ts.snap}`, `packages/protocol/src/{transcript,session}.ts`, `packages/protocol/fixtures/{transcript-cases.ts,transcript.json}`, `apps/web/{src/transcript.tsx,static/app.js}`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/{transcript,session,taskpage,taskturns}.go`, `design/{focus-window,product-model,ui}.md` |

放心 nothing runs before its turn, a part that fails stops the line and says so in plain words, taking a group apart never loses work; 惊喜 the third part is already in line, from the second's branch, before you think of it. **(1) Made by the partner**, never filed by hand first: `task_open` takes `group` (one short name on every part of a split; the partner opens every part at once, in order), `task_group` takes the person's words ("把这几件放一起", rename, ungroup); by hand on the web from the selection bar (**放进一个分组 / Put in a group**, a name, **放进去**); a group is shown from two parts. **(2) One card** in the state section of its most urgent part (a stopped line: 等你), the name in the display face, beads one per part, **{n} 件里做完 {k} 件 / {k} of {n} done**, the parts numbered on a thread (done, at work, needs you, waits, didn't work out, **排着 / In line**), each opening its task; a part that needs the person shows its question inside the card. A card of more than three folds to what is live and the next in line (**还有 {n} 件 / {n} more**). Counts stay per task; not while finding, nor in the rail (rows). **(3) The line**: parts in the same folder on the same computer run one after another (**一件做完接下一件 / One after another**); elsewhere side by side (**同时做 / Side by side**, switchable). A later part is held by the home, its `task_open` input kept, no task or agent until its turn; it opens when the part before it is done (a result back, `done_claimed`, counts: a task stays there until merged) from that part's unmerged branch, its brief led by which part it is and what the one before reported; merged first: from the base. A part that needs the person holds the line; one that fails or is put down stops it: **第 2 件没做成，第 3 件在等你决定。** (**后面 {n} 件** for several) with **再试第 2 件 / Try part 2 again** (continues it; done, the line moves by itself), **不管它，做第 3 件 / Skip it, do part 3**, **第 3 件也不做了 / 后面的不做了 / Drop the rest**; it counts as one thing that needs you. **提前 / Move up** reorders what hasn't started; **改成同时做 / 改成一件做完接下一件** switches; **取消分组（任务都留着） / Ungroup (the tasks stay)** takes it apart and opens what was held at once. Groups and held parts survive a restart (`<dataDir>/task-groups.json`). **(4) The word** 分组 / Group, not the reference's 分区 / Section (research/133: read as deleting tasks by 7 of 12; Group clearest, least jargon); the card never labels itself, its name is the group's own. *Tradeoff:* a held part can't start early even when the person would have liked it to (they switch the group to side by side). *Alternative not taken:* user-made sidebar sections (the reference product's): filing is a chore the partner can do, and it would not stop parts in one repo colliding. | the author (2026-11-18), research/133; D36, D216, D261, D287, D291, D315, D359 | `packages/{protocol/src/{task-groups,index}.ts,core/src/{task-groups,core,ws}.ts,core/test/task-groups.test.ts,partner/src/{partner,render}.ts,partner/eval/,runner/src/normalize.ts}`, `apps/web/src/{onhand.tsx,groups-view.ts,i18n-groups.ts,i18n.ts}`, `apps/web/{static/app.css,demo-groups.ts,test/groups.test.ts}`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/protocol.go,views/{groups,groups_test,onhandlist,onhandboard}.go,i18n/groups.go}`, `design/{on-hand,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/on-hand.md`, `research/{133-task-groups,README}.md` |

## 2026-11-18: an AI agent's update says what it is doing while it runs; Codex's download comes first, watched, into npm's own cache (D362; the author on the Mac app 0.0.77, 正在全部更新: "Macbook Pro M3 上的 Codex 0.169.1 → 0.170.0 正在更新到 0.170.0…" "卡了半天" while Hetzner's finished quickly. D358 is the latest on main and D359–D361 may be held by branches in flight: may need renumbering at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D362 | **Built 2026-11-18 (core, worker, web, the Mac), checked by unit tests with a fake installer that streams, stalls, never ends and is stopped, a real download from a local server, Go view tests, and the real home driven by a pretend worker in headless Chrome (`apps/web/demo-agent-update.ts`; shots `.shots/agent-update/`). The cache path was run for real only into scratch prefixes (research/131); no real update on the author's Mac yet.** *Cause (measured):* Codex from npm is a 13 KB launcher whose binary is an aliased optional dependency, 155 MB for 0.170.0 darwin-arm64, plus a 19.5 MB packument, new for every version; npm fetched them silently and Ducter's runner buffered everything to the end: 12.5 min cold here at ~200 KB/s (past the old 10 min kill, which would have said "unchanged"), 12–14 s from a warm cache. Hetzner's link made the same step quick. *Who:* the developer with Codex on a laptop on home Wi-Fi, the consumer on a slow line, the fresh user who only sees a line that doesn't move. *Felt before:* a frozen line, no way to tell slow from stuck, nothing to do but wait. *After:* 顺滑 the line moves; 放心 it says how far and that the version they have still works; one quiet choice when it is really slow. **(1) Watched download, npm kept.** Where harness-facts names the binary's tarball (`channels.npmBlob`, Codex), after the safe point and with the agent still working, Ducter downloads it from the registry npm itself uses (`npm config get registry`), puts it in npm's own cache (`npm cache add <file>`, stored by the sha512 the install asks for) with the package's metadata beside it, then holds the agent and runs the same `npm install -g` with `--prefer-offline --no-audit` (seconds). A source that won't serve it falls back to npm's own download. The person's install method is never switched (GitHub's 82 MB `.zst` was rejected for that). **(2) Live words** (both clients, the Update all row and the coin's row): **正在下载（61 / 155 MB）**, without a size **正在下载（38 MB）**, without bytes **正在下载… 1 分 20 秒**; **正在装好…**; for an updater Ducter can't see inside (brew, the agents' own installers) **正在更新到 0.170.0… 2 分 5 秒** after 10 s; then 在检查 as before. Wire: `step`, `got`, `size`, `since` (the updater's start, the home's clock), at most one frame a second. **(3) Slower than usual:** past 3× this agent's last update on that computer (never under 90 s; 4 min with none known; kept in `updates/agent-times.json`), one quiet line under the row, **比平常慢，可能是网络慢**, with **再等等** (hides it for another stretch) and **停止** (`update_all {stopItem}` → the home's own abort or `agent_update_stop` to the worker): the step reads **已停止**, the version they have untouched, and the plan goes on. **(4) Hard limits:** no bytes for 2 min or 30 min in all stops the download; an updater that downloads by itself gets 25 min (was 10); either fails as `timeout`, **下载太久没完成，已经停下了，原来的版本照常能用。网络好些时再试一次。**, with the plan's **再试一次**. *Alternative not taken:* only an elapsed time on the old single step (no bytes, no clean stop, the agent held for the whole download). *Not covered:* a registry token or a proxy only `.npmrc` knows (the fallback, with the time shown). | U (the author, 2026-11-18), research/131; D156, D224, D227 | `packages/protocol/src/{index,harness-facts}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{agents,download,update,update-all,ws,core}.ts`, `packages/cli/src/worker.ts`, `packages/core/test/agent-download.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/{agent-progress.ts,updateall.tsx,devcard.tsx,i18n-updateall.ts}`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/test/agent-progress.test.ts`, `apps/web/demo-agent-update.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/protocol.go,i18n/updateall.go,views/{agentprogress,agentprogress_test,updateall,agentversion}.go}`, `design/{system,product-model}.md`, `docs/devices.md`, `research/{131-agent-update-download,README}.md` |

## 2026-11-18: a computer added for tasks gets its AI agents from Ducter, finds the ones you installed, and signs them in from where you are (D363; the author on haswell, 0.0.77: the card showed only a greyed pi and 再登录一个, "里边的 harness 需要亲自安装", "我安装了 codex，这边 devices 也识别不出来", then "从空服务器 bootstrap 需要的 harness，丝滑的 onboarding；最好 harness 可以在 devices 里一键安装". D358 is on main and another branch may take D363: this may need renumbering at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D363 | **Built 2026-11-18; checked live on two Ubuntu 24.04 VMs (colima, a normal user, nothing but curl) against a scratch home on this Mac, no account signed in (research/132).** *Who:* the heavy developer lending a bare server (the author's haswell, which he will wipe and lend again from the release); the consumer lending a NAS; the fresh user who has never installed an AI agent. *Felt before:* the line joined in seconds and then nothing could run there: no agent, no way to get one from Ducter, a pi that wasn't there shown greyed, a Codex installed by hand invisible for half an hour, and signing in meant an SSH session. *After:* 好用 one question, one button, one sign-in each, all from the sheet; 顺滑 the agents arrive on the clay one by one; 赏心悦目 the same coin rows as the card; 放心 nothing needs a password, everything goes in Ducter's own folder there, and the sign-in is each agent's own; 惊喜 a Codex installed by hand appears within seconds. **Root causes (verified live on 0.0.77):** (a) a worker probed its agents only at its welcome and every 30 minutes, so `~/.local/bin/codex` installed after joining stayed "not installed" until a restart (shown at once after one); (b) the service's PATH was the install shell's plus `~/.local/bin` and `~/.bun/bin`, so nvm, fnm, a custom npm prefix or Linuxbrew were never looked in; (c) Bun's `which` reads the PATH the process started with and ignores a later change (Bun 1.4.4), so any widening had to be passed explicitly; (d) pi counted as installed when `node` was on PATH, though the single binary runs only a `pi` command (the greyed pi); (e) Ducter never installed an agent anywhere, and signing in was only "on that computer itself". **(1) Finding.** A worker's PATH is widened on start and on every probe: the login shell's PATH (`$SHELL -lic`, captured when the service is installed and again at each start, kept in `<data>/login-path`), the usual per-user folders (`~/.local/bin`, npm's prefix from `~/.npmrc`, `~/.npm-global`, every nvm and fnm node newest first, volta, asdf, mise, bun, pnpm, Linuxbrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`), then Ducter's tools folder last; the person's own copy wins. Every agent lookup asks with the current PATH (`whichNow`). **(2) Looking again.** Every 5 s the worker takes a fingerprint without starting a process (where each agent's command is and its time, the sign-in files' times) and probes for real when it moves; on start, at each welcome, every 30 minutes, and when a device card opens (`agent_setup` `look`). **(3) Installing.** `agent_setup` `install` puts Codex, Claude Code and pi in `<data>/tools` on that computer: Node.js's own build (24.22.3, SHA-256 pinned per platform), then each agent's npm package at the newest version Ducter verified (harness-facts `verified.to`), one at a time, no sudo, nothing outside that folder; the copies read as npm-installed there, so D156's updates reach them. Fails into one line (没连上网 / 空间不够 / 装不了 / 没装上) and **再试一次**. **(4) Signing in** with each agent's own sign-in, run on that computer and carried to the person: Codex `codex login --device-auth` (its link and one-time code; device sign-in off in the account says to turn it on), Claude Code `claude auth login` (its link; the code its page gives is pasted back and written to the sign-in's input; a wrong one asks again), pi (no sign-in that runs without its own screen: the row says to run pi and /login there). 15 minutes, then it stops. **(5) Where.** The lend sheet's last step asks **装上哪些 AI？/ Which AIs should it have?** with Codex and Claude Code checked and pi not, **装上 / Install** and **以后再说 / Later**; then each agent as its row (**正在装上… / Installing…**, **等着装 / Waiting to install**, **登录 / Sign in** with its sign-in in place, **可以用了 / Ready**), and **{name} 可以干活了 / {name} is ready for tasks** once one is signed in. Every device card (a worker's and the home's) shows the same rows: an agent not there has **安装 / Install** in the socket's detail, one going in arrives as its coin with a ring, a coin not signed in opens on **登录**. The Mac this app runs Ducter on keeps its own account sheet. The partner and New task see an agent the moment its row says signed in (D353's refusal then stops). *Tradeoff:* about 700 MB in Ducter's folder for all three (Node and Claude Code's native build are most of it), and two to four minutes on a slow line. *Alternative not taken:* each agent's own installer (Claude's into `~/.local`, Codex's standalone, pi's needing node and a terminal): three ways to fail and one of them interactive; npm under Ducter's own node is one way, pinned, checked and removable. | the author (2026-11-18), research/132; D85, D102, D156, D347, D353, D358 | `packages/core/src/{agent-path,agent-setup,harness-probe,devices,core,ws,workers}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/{index,which}.ts`, `packages/cli/src/{worker,remote,doctor,update-agents}.ts`, `packages/runner/src/oar.ts`, `apps/web/src/{agent-setup,agent-setup-view,i18n-agentsetup,devcard,lend,app}.ts(x)`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/desktop/internal/{views/{agentsetup,devicecard,lend,devupdate},i18n/agentsetup,protocol/protocol}.go`, `docs/add-a-computer.md`, `design/{where,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `research/{132-worker-agents,README}.md` |
